sentences.en: The bulk of his work is in the urban area.
sentences.zh: 他大部分的工作都在市区进行。

sentences.en: Urban culture appears to be attractive to the younger generation.
sentences.zh: 都市文化似乎对年轻人很有吸引力。

sentences.en: Ordinarily, urban planners do not view pedestrians as important traffic.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，城市规划者并不认为行人是重要的交通参与者。

senses.zh: 都市的,具有城市或城市生活特点的,市内
